cmd: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'python*' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*siri*tools*worker.py*' -and $_.CommandLine -notlike '*telugucouple*' }; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('killing pid ' + $_.ProcessId + ' ' + $_.CommandLine); Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force } } else { Write-Output 'siri worker not running' }; Start-Sleep 2; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'python*' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*worker.py*' } | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('still running: ' + $_.ProcessId + ' ' + $_.CommandLine) }"
